name: DOE TCF lab call — CLIMR: Technology Specific Topics (FY2026 & FY2027)
description: Checks the numbers a CLIMR Technology Specific Topics proposal puts on its title page (Appendix C) against the requirements the lab call states in words. Every check quotes the requirement it tests, with its page.
note: A self-check against the lab-call text only. DOE determines eligibility and merit; passing these checks does not make a proposal responsive.

topics.name: Office of Critical Minerals and Energy Innovation (CMEI)
Office of Cybersecurity, Energy Security, and Emergency Response (CESER)

requirements.text: Unless otherwise stated in a topic or AOI, technologies must be at a minimum Technology Readiness Level (TRL) of 4 at the time of writing a concept paper, using TRLs defined by the DOE.

Proposals must use the Adoption Readiness Level (ARL) framework to evaluate technology risks, ecosystem economics, and private sector uptake potential, and must show an increase in ARL during the project period of performance.
Address what the project intends to accomplish to advance the technology’s readiness for commercialization, including current and end project targeted ARL and TRL

source.section: IV. Technology Specific Topics — proposed projects must do all of the following
IV.v. Office of Nuclear Energy (NE) — recommended parameters for all submissions under this topic area

requirements.text: Within the Adoption Readiness Level (ARL) tool, the ‘License to Operate' core risk area (section D) should not contain any 'high risks' for deployment/ commercialization

source.section: IV.v. Office of Nuclear Energy (NE) — recommended parameters for all submissions under this topic area

requirements.text: Provide an explanation of the starting and ending TRL and ARL. Please note there is a minimum starting TRL requirement of 4 for all proposals; however, there may be additional requirements in each of the program office topic or AOI descriptions, when listed.
Provide justification on the starting and ending TRL and ARL.

source.section: V.iii. Full Applications — Technical Volume, Potential Commercialization Advances

requirements.text: Note: TRL and ARL values should be provided quantitatively as a number, not qualitatively nor as a range.
